missing_state: exclude unassigned existing cluster from network only
gene_selection: Within mean-expression bins, rank normalized dispersion of log1p(total-1e4-normalized) values. Reserve expressed nonconstant prespecified genes. Lock gene panel on main before perturbations.
controls: Nearest expressed perturbable nonendpoint TFs by equally weighted standardised log mean RNA, detection fraction, log1p out-degree. Exact ties alphabetical. No outcome-based filtering.
patient_aggregation: median of cell deltas per patient; median across patients. Stratify by original cluster and frozen H05/H10/H50/L50 membership.
stability: 20 without-replacement patient subsets, fraction 0.8, true refits. Sign agreement vs primary with zero separate. Ranges are min-max.
prior_policy: versioned human promoter motif base GRN if obtainable; use complete model-input mapping, no hand-added edges.
rank: rank descending absolute patient-balanced response among structurally reachable evaluable non-KO genes, ties average
status: >=4 patients and >=80 cells per fit, >=3 detected patients and >=10 positive cells for source and endpoint; a signed response needs a fitted path within propagation depth. Pooled estimates require >=4 patients. Subgroup with <4 patients exploratory.
